# MicMikes Paints - Keekorok Edition

> Premium Kenyan paint brand selling landscape-inspired emulsion, eggshell, satin and semi-gloss finishes online, with an AI-powered room colour visualizer, M-Pesa checkout, and free Nairobi delivery over KES 15,000.

MicMikes Paints is a Nairobi-based e-commerce paint retailer. Customers browse 20 Kenyan-landmark-inspired colours, preview them on real room photos with a wall-only recolour visualizer, and order paint in 1L, 4L, and 20L tins priced in Kenyan shillings.

## Products
- Keekorok Matte Emulsion, Satin Silk Finish, Eggshell Heritage, Semi-Gloss Acrylic
- Deep Penetrating Primer and painting supplies
- Sizes: 1L, 4L, 20L. Prices in KES. Payment via M-Pesa.

## Key features
- Room Visualizer: select a colour and see only the walls repainted on real interior photos
- 20 curated colours grouped by family (Neutrals, Warm Earth, Cool Green, Blue, Red & Terracotta, Yellow & Gold)
- Free delivery in Nairobi on orders over KES 15,000

## Crawler policy
- Public pages may be crawled and summarised.
- Do not crawl /admin (private dashboard) or /api/ (endpoints).
